description: Repository evolution endpoints must use entity_kind='repository'

Repository identity is isolated across lineage steps
Relationship IDs are deterministically derived via SHA-256
Every relationship has non-empty grounded provenance
Provenance references authentic fixtures with cryptographic SHA-256 digests

Repository evolution never establishes work-item to PR linkage
Explicit Jira-GitHub relationships remain authoritative and un-upgraded
Repository evolution never transfers work-item state
External dependency state does not complete or block first-party work
Temporal ordering is preserved and distinct from causality
Temporal proximity does not infer defect, blame, or causality
PROJECT_LINEAGE is a directed acyclic graph (DAG)
NAVIGATION_ROUTING is strictly acyclic without self-loops
Graph identity is provider-scoped (source_kind:instance_id:entity_id)
Production evaluator is never invoked on repository relationships directly
No Cartesian cross-system pairing or entity kind contamination
Semantically conflicting duplicate IDs fail closed (ValueError / contradictory)
Path A (without repo evolution) == Path B (with repo evolution) evaluation output
Simultaneous presence of all 8 evidence collection types preserves pairwise orthogonality
Navigation routing records contextual evolution without altering referenced endpoints
Unresolved, stale, and ambiguous references are scoped without cascade suppression
Arbitrary permutation of compound evidence collections produces strictly identical digests
